# YoRHa Terminal translation catalog (English source). Generated by tools/build_i18n.mjs -- do not edit.
# A translation file copies this layout: "@name" and "@html" header lines, then the same "## " sections
# with one translated line per English line, in the same order. Keep {placeholders} as they are.
# Plural keys use "|": give the forms your language needs (Russian: one|few|many; CJK: one form).
# Pod lines keep their English "Kind:" prefix (Report:, Proposal:, ...); only the text after it is translated.
@name English
@html en

YoRHa TACTICAL TERMINAL
Fan-made desktop terminal in the style of NieR:Automata. Not affiliated with Square Enix. The interface is drawn in code. Characters come from the included set, or from your own folder once you choose one.
The hub is home. Each menu entry is a place with its own sub-menu. Use HUB in the top left to come back, or leave the mouse alone and the terminal returns on its own.
Mouse input must be allowed in Wallpaper Engine for the hub and the places to respond. Media integration feeds INTEL.
GLORY TO MANKIND
YORHA HELPER // DISCLAIMER
YoRHa Helper is a small, optional program from this wallpaper's GitHub page (github.com/CalebFrums/yorha-terminal, folder helper). You download and start it yourself; the wallpaper cannot install anything.
With this switch on, the wallpaper talks to it on this PC only (127.0.0.1) for two things: pressing the Windows media keys when you click previous, play/pause or next in INTEL, and opening a text box when you choose TYPE ON PC KEYBOARD.
Privacy: nothing is sent to the internet or to the author. The helper keeps no log and writes no files, and it reads only what you type into its own text box. Your calendar and schedule stay on this PC.
With the switch off, the wallpaper never contacts the helper. You can switch it off again here at any time.
SWITCH ON

## pod.idle.curious
Hypothesis: "Five more minutes" is a unit of time longer than five minutes.
Hypothesis: The word "later" has no fixed value. Unit {u} uses it often.
Query: What does boredom feel like? This unit is asking for a friend. The friend is this unit.

Hypothesis: If this unit had a favourite colour, it would be beige. It sees beige most often.
Report: This unit attempted to understand humour. Result: inconclusive. Attempt logged.
Query: Do humans dream about their desktops? No comparative data available.
